feedback:
Evidence: iteration 6 (kp 2.25, kd 1.2, ki 0, base 1.2, 16 mm sensors at x = ±0.03 m, mass 0.6, body 0.14) is the best raced design at 909.8. Its oval (20/20, 2.05 s) and s-bend (20/20, 2.38 s) are solid, and the slalom (16/20, 4 off-track, 0.2 line-loss events, rms 0.012 m, oscillation 0.26) is the remaining gap. Iteration 7 lowered kp to 2.0 and got worse (slalom 11/20, 0.6 line-loss events), so turn authority matters. Iteration 8 raised kd to 1.5 and gave no gain (907.6), so derivative damping looks saturated. The candidate is a single-variable change from iteration 6: kp 2.25 to 2.5 with everything else unchanged. It follows the evidence on turn authority, and kp 2.5 at this spread has not been tested directly. The iteration 5 result (kp 3.0 with a ±4 cm spread) is confounded by the spread change, so it does not rule kp 2.5 out. Nothing is claimed about how this candidate will perform.

Read the next race this way. If slalom finishes reach 17/20 or more with line_loss_events at or below 0.2 and steering_oscillation at or below 0.3, keep kp 2.5 as the new reference. If slalom finishes fall below 16/20, or line_loss_events rise above 0.3, the proportional gain has passed its useful point and the next step is kp 2.25 with ki 0.1, which is the only knob untested. If steering_oscillation rises above 0.35 or control_effort jumps on any track, return to kp 2.25 and add ki 0.1 rather than raising kp further. If the slalom off-track exits persist at about 0.2 line-loss events whatever the gain, the footprint is the limit, so test 12 mm sensors at the iteration 6 spread.
requested_changes: If slalom finishes fall below 16/20 or line_loss_events rise above 0.3: set controller.kp back to 2.25 and controller.ki to 0.1, since iteration 7 showed that lower kp hurts and ki has not been tried yet.

If steering_oscillation rises above 0.35 or control_effort jumps on any track at kp 2.5: return controller.kp to 2.25, keep kd 1.2, and try controller.ki 0.1, since iteration 6 oscillation was 0.20 to 0.26 and iteration 8 showed kd 1.5 adds nothing.

If slalom off-track exits persist with line_loss_events near 0.2 at any kp: change geometry.sensor_size from 0.016 to 0.012 at the iteration 6 spread (±0.03 m, weights -2 to 2), since the wider spread in iteration 5 did not reduce line loss (0.3 per run).
